decisions.reason: A same-message MODIFY already fully records that the approved second V is locked and must be carried forward unchanged unless the client explicitly requests a change.
A same-message MODIFY already fully records that the approved É accent is locked and must be carried forward unchanged unless the client explicitly requests a change.
A same-message MODIFY already captures the locked terminal treatment and its preservation policy; the Hero V lock requires no additional update or removal.
A same-message MODIFY already records that E and L exploration must occur around the locked Hero V, second V, and É accent while those assets remain unchanged.
The alignment requirement already treats the approved Hero V as the fixed reference and requires the accent and surrounding type to adapt to it; locking the Hero V does not change that state.
Locking the Hero V geometry does not alter the established second-V height hierarchy, and the source does not specify a new hierarchy value.
The fixed Hero V remains compatible with continued spacing and rhythm exploration under the existing governing-principles constraint; no kerning state changes are entailed.
The Hero V locking decision does not change the deferred champagne material treatment or its role in enhancing the resolved design.
The asset-lock decision does not change the obligation to explain the design rationale and translation of architectural principles in review rounds.
